spec.title: Учетные цены на Золото от ЦБ, руб./гр.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(
        toString(toYear(date)),
        'H',
        toString(intDiv(toMonth(date) - 1, 6) + 1)
    ) AS half,
    avg(price)
FROM default.cbr_gold
WHERE
    date >= $__fromTime
    AND date <= $__toTime
GROUP BY half
ORDER BY min(date);

SELECT
    concat(
        toString(toYear(date)),
        'H',
        toString(intDiv(toMonth(date) - 1, 6) + 1)
    ) AS half,
    avg(price)
FROM default.cbr_currency_usd
WHERE
    date >= $__fromTime
    AND date <= $__toTime
GROUP BY half
ORDER BY min(date);

spec.title: Учетные цены на Золото от ЦБ, $./ унция

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(
        toString(toYear(date)),
        'H',
        toString(intDiv(toMonth(date) - 1, 6) + 1)
    ) AS half,
    avg(g.price / usd.price * 31.1034768) AS gold_usd_per_ounce
FROM default.cbr_gold AS g
INNER JOIN default.cbr_currency_usd AS usd
    ON g.date = usd.date
WHERE
    g.date >= $__fromTime
    AND g.date <= $__toTime
GROUP BY half
ORDER BY min(date);

SELECT parseDateTimeBestEffort(
        replace(replace(period, 'H1', '-01-01'), 'H2', '-07-01')
    ) AS dt, value
FROM "default"."polyus_financial_metrics" WHERE ( metric = 'capex' ) AND ( period_type = 'H' ) LIMIT 1000

SELECT parseDateTimeBestEffort(replace(period, 'FY', '-12-30')
    ) AS dt, value as CAPEX
FROM "default"."polyus_financial_metrics" FINAL WHERE ( metric = 'capex' ) AND ( period_type = 'FY' )
UNION ALL
SELECT
    toDateTime('2026-12-30') AS dt,
    2500 AS CAPEX
UNION ALL
SELECT
    toDateTime('2027-12-30') AS dt,
    2500 AS CAPEX
ORDER BY dt;
